preamble: The voiceless postalveolar fricative [ʃ] becomes the palatal glide [j] before a stop. The clearest case is Western Samic, where Proto-Samic *š in the clusters *šk and *št vocalized to j (Proto-Samic *kuoškë 'rapids' > Northern Sami guoika).

languageExamples.language: Western Samic (Northern, Lule, Pite, Ume, South)

examples.to: Northern Sami guoika, Lule Sami guojkka, South Sami goejhke
examples.note: In West Samic *š became j before a stop; East Samic keeps the sibilant (Inari kuošˈkâ, Skolt kuõškk).
